name: Terrarium 70x40x35
label: Large terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 70x40x35 cm. Volume: 98.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 70x40x35 cm terrarium has 2800 cm² of floor and 98 liters. At 35 cm high it stays low, so it does not dominate the room, while the 70x40 cm floor is already a serious area for ground-dwelling species. It comes without a 3D background, with sliding glass at the front and film on the other sides.

A medium-sized ball python has the length for two hides and the width to curl up beside them. Young tortoises and a young blue-tongued skink use the whole floor, so put decor along the edges. A heat lamp at one end and 70 cm of length give a clear warm and cool zone. It suits a bearded dragon only while it is young.

Taller models of similar length are the 70x45x70 and 70x50x50 +3D. If you want a 3D background in these dimensions, we add it to order. We ship by courier to all towns in Serbia. A build with a background or in another size needs 7 to 14 days.
